name: m7-normativos
description: Create and review M7 corporate normative documents (POL/MAN/INS/ESP) following POL-M7-001 standards. The creating-politica skill emits an autocontido trio {slug}.html + {slug}.yaml + {slug}.review.md — HTML ~1.4MB with CSS, TWK Everett fonts and logos inlined as base64 (works from file:// or HTTP); YAML sidecar canônico for the M7 Cockpit de Normativos; review.md filled by the politica-design-reviewer agent (mandatory Score >= B gate). Template-based pipeline with 145 placeholders covering identity + content of 8 sections, mapped from BRIEFING.md (YAML) + politica-{slug}.md (structured markdown with catalogued shortcodes). v4.0 BREAKING: MD da Fase 2 não aceita mais HTML inline com classes CSS, <style> blocks, ou style="..." inline — toda apresentação visual vem de 5 shortcodes pré-aprovados (:::papel-card, :::callout, :::indicador, :::diagrama, :::processo-grid). Allowlist de classes CSS aplicada pós-render. Agente politica-design-reviewer compara contra gold reference e produz Score A/B/C/D + Quick Fix CSS — gate obrigatório para entrega. 3-phase workflow: Discovery → Redação MD → Produção HTML+YAML+Review. MAN/INS/ESP skills still emit DOCX (migration pending). Includes governance-writer agent.
